title: Form DailyLog v2
description: One day's log. `readiness` is that morning's check-in and becomes the label for the day before. Only `date` is required; missing fields are filled with the model's typical value and listed in missing_inputs.

tomorrow_tags.description: Planned tags for tomorrow; if absent, Mon-Fri counts as a workday

readiness.description: Morning check-in: how ready do you feel (0-10 slider x 10)

readiness_history.description: Morning readiness for the 6 days before, oldest first; fill with withHistory()

sleep_hours.description: Sleep of the night that ended this morning

workout_minutes.description: Total training minutes today; 0 = no training

load_history.description: Training load (minutes x effort) for the 6 days before; fill with withHistory()

calories_consumed.description: Stored for Goal mode and future models; not used by the v2 score

protein_g.description: Not used by the v2 score

fat_g.description: Not used by the v2 score

carbs_g.description: Not used by the v2 score
